name: Circus of Stars
source:
After finally leaving your psychotic father and his mad circus, four years passed by in the blink of an eye.  To confront your biggest fears once and for all, you revisit the circus to see him one last time and to revisit the one thing you left behind, but mending broken friendships isn’t easy as someone you once knew, can be a total stranger.  However, after your confrontation, news reached your ear that your father was found dead.  You must revisit your past once again to uncover the truth, but the truth may not be what you think it is. 

[From [url=https://burnt-bun.itch.io/circus-of-stars]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
终于离开精神病父亲和他疯狂的马戏团后，四年的时光一眨眼就过去了。为了一劳永逸地面对你最大的恐惧，你重新回到马戏团，最后一次见到他，并重新审视你留下的一件事，但修复破裂的友谊并不容易，因为你曾经认识的人可能完全陌生。然而，在你们对峙之后，你的耳朵里传来了你父亲被发现死亡的消息。你必须再次回顾你的过去才能揭开真相，但真相可能不是你想象的那样。

[来自[url=https://burnt-bun.itch.io/circus-of-stars]itch.io[/url]]
